title: SonarQube User token (squ_): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: SQU_ vs the lower-case squ_ and prefix: sqx_, a type letter TokenType does not define. Twin of "SonarQube User token (squ_): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of sonarqube-token-bearer-header: prefix: sqx_, a type letter TokenType does not define. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
